summary_1line: Tara’s calming words soften Lakshmana’s anger, leading Sugriva to apologize humbly and reaffirm loyalty to Rama, restoring harmony between them.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sugriva pulls the bright garland from his neck and throws it aside as his drunken haze lifts, speaking humbly before the stern Lakshmana.
Tara stands calmly before the armed Lakshmana, her composed words easing the tension in the monkey court.
